rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: White Magic
rows.Origin: Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 1998 as 'White Magic'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
